lookback_summary: Well, what a weekend it was! The model really nailed the Nott'm Forest vs Arsenal clash, correctly predicting that Arsenal would come away with the win. That match ended with Arsenal taking the victory 1-0, a tidy little result for those who backed them. However, I had to eat humble pie on the Tottenham vs Coventry City fixture, where the model called for a Not Home win but Tottenham proved their home strength with a solid 3-1 victory. Sometimes, you just can't predict the heart of a home side!
